---
# Negative control for the handout guard, and a sibling of reject-bad-size.
# `a-4` is a plausible typo for `a4` and names no paper the template knows.
#
# Silently ignoring it is the specific failure worth stopping: the render
# would succeed and hand back a full-size poster, which is exactly what the
# author sees when the option is spelled correctly but not supported — so the
# one way to tell "no handout" from "handout ignored" is that this fails.
title: "Handout guard fixture"
format:
  sciposter-typst:
    poster:
      size: a1
      columns: 1
      handout: a-4
---

Body.
